declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.eq_sum_map_of_eqns
declarations.statement: {F : List α → Nat} (f : α → Nat) (h0 : F [] = 0) (hc : ∀ a l, F (a :: l) = f a + F l) : ∀ l, F l = (l.map f).sum
declarations.doc: A function on lists with `F [] = 0` and `F (a :: l) = f a + F l` (a sum restated by recursion) is the sum of the mapped list, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.eq_sum_map_of_eqns_int
declarations.statement: {F : List α → Int} (f : α → Int) (h0 : F [] = 0) (hc : ∀ a l, F (a :: l) = f a + F l) : ∀ l, F l = (l.map f).sum
declarations.doc: A function on lists with `F [] = 0` and `F (a :: l) = f a + F l` is the sum of the mapped list, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.eq_sumOver_of_eqns
declarations.statement: {F : List α → Int} (f : α → Int) (h0 : F [] = 0) (hc : ∀ a l, F (a :: l) = f a + F l) (l : List α) : F l = sumOver l f
declarations.doc: A function on lists with `F [] = 0` and `F (a :: l) = f a + F l` is `sumOver l f`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.eq_sum_range_of_eqns
declarations.statement: {F : Nat → Nat} (f : Nat → Nat) (h0 : F 0 = 0) (hs : ∀ n, F (n + 1) = F n + f n) : ∀ n, F n = ((List.range n).map f).sum
declarations.doc: A function on `Nat` with `F 0 = 0` and `F (n + 1) = F n + f n` (a sum over the first `n` indices restated by recursion) is the sum of `f` over `List.range n`, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.eq_sum_range_of_eqns_int
declarations.statement: {F : Nat → Int} (f : Nat → Int) (h0 : F 0 = 0) (hs : ∀ n, F (n + 1) = F n + f n) : ∀ n, F n = ((List.range n).map f).sum
declarations.doc: A function on `Nat` with `F 0 = 0` and `F (n + 1) = F n + f n` is the sum of `f` over `List.range n`, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.eq_sumOver_range_of_eqns
declarations.statement: {F : Nat → Int} (f : Nat → Int) (h0 : F 0 = 0) (hs : ∀ n, F (n + 1) = F n + f n) (n : Nat) : F n = sumOver (List.range n) f
declarations.doc: A function on `Nat` with `F 0 = 0` and `F (n + 1) = F n + f n` is `sumOver (List.range n) f`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.foldl_add_eq
declarations.statement: (f : α → Nat) : ∀ (l : List α) (c : Nat), l.foldl (fun acc a => acc + f a) c = c + (l.map f).sum
declarations.doc: A left fold that adds `f a` for every element is the start value plus the sum, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.foldl_add_eq_int
declarations.statement: (f : α → Int) : ∀ (l : List α) (c : Int), l.foldl (fun acc a => acc + f a) c = c + (l.map f).sum
declarations.doc: A left fold that adds `f a` for every element is the start value plus the sum, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.foldr_add_eq
declarations.statement: (f : α → Nat) (l : List α) : l.foldr (fun a acc => f a + acc) 0 = (l.map f).sum
declarations.doc: A right fold that adds `f a` for every element, from `0`, is the sum, on `Nat` (the `Nat` counterpart of `sumOver`).

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.map_getD_range
declarations.statement: (d : α) : ∀ l : List α, (List.range l.length).map (fun i => l.getD i d) = l
declarations.doc: A list read back position by position is the list.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_eq_sum_range
declarations.statement: (f : α → Nat) (d : α) (l : List α) : (l.map f).sum = ((List.range l.length).map (fun i => f (l.getD i d))).sum
declarations.doc: A sum over a list is the sum over its positions of the summand of the element there, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_eq_sum_range_int
declarations.statement: (f : α → Int) (d : α) (l : List α) : (l.map f).sum = ((List.range l.length).map (fun i => f (l.getD i d))).sum
declarations.doc: A sum over a list is the sum over its positions of the summand of the element there, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_eq_sumOver_range_getD
declarations.statement: (f : α → Int) (d : α) (l : List α) : sumOver l f = sumOver (List.range l.length) (fun i => f (l.getD i d))
declarations.doc: `sumOver` a list is `sumOver` its positions of the summand of the element there.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_eq_sumOver_range
declarations.statement: (l : List α) (h : α → Int) (g : Nat → Int) (hg : ∀ i (hi : i < l.length), h l[i] = g i) : sumOver l h = sumOver (List.range l.length) g
declarations.doc: A sum over a list equals the sum of `g` over its positions when the summand of the element at every position `i` is `g i` (for example a share looked up by the element's position).

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_eq_sum_range_of_getElem
declarations.statement: (l : List α) (h : α → Nat) (g : Nat → Nat) (hg : ∀ i (hi : i < l.length), h l[i] = g i) : (l.map h).sum = ((List.range l.length).map g).sum
declarations.doc: A sum over a list equals the sum of `g` over its positions when the summand of the element at every position `i` is `g i`, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_succ_head
declarations.statement: (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : ((List.range (n + 1)).map f).sum = f 0 + ((List.range n).map (fun i => f (i + 1))).sum
declarations.doc: The first position of a sum over `List.range (n + 1)` split off, the rest shifted by one, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_succ_head_int
declarations.statement: (f : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : ((List.range (n + 1)).map f).sum = f 0 + ((List.range n).map (fun i => f (i + 1))).sum
declarations.doc: The first position of a sum over `List.range (n + 1)` split off, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_range_succ_head
declarations.statement: (f : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : sumOver (List.range (n + 1)) f = f 0 + sumOver (List.range n) (fun i => f (i + 1))
declarations.doc: The first position of `sumOver (List.range (n + 1)) f` split off.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_succ_tail
declarations.statement: (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : ((List.range (n + 1)).map f).sum = ((List.range n).map f).sum + f n
declarations.doc: The last position of a sum over `List.range (n + 1)` split off, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_succ_tail_int
declarations.statement: (f : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : ((List.range (n + 1)).map f).sum = ((List.range n).map f).sum + f n
declarations.doc: The last position of a sum over `List.range (n + 1)` split off, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_indicator
declarations.statement: (m : Nat) : ∀ n : Nat, ((List.range n).map (fun i => if i < m then 1 else 0)).sum = min m n
declarations.doc: Of `n` positions, `min m n` are below `m`: the indicator of the first `m` positions sums to `min m n`, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_indicator_int
declarations.statement: (m : Nat) (n : Nat) : ((List.range n).map (fun i => if i < m then (1 : Int) else 0)).sum = (min m n : Nat)
declarations.doc: The indicator of the first `m` positions sums to `min m n` over `n` positions, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_range_indicator
declarations.statement: (m n : Nat) : sumOver (List.range n) (fun i => if i < m then (1 : Int) else 0) = (min m n : Nat)
declarations.doc: The indicator of the first `m` positions sums to `min m n` over `n` positions, as `sumOver`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_ite_eq
declarations.statement: (x c : Nat) : ∀ n : Nat, ((List.range n).map (fun i => if i = x then c else 0)).sum = if x < n then c else 0
declarations.doc: A value at one position `x`, summed over `n` positions, is the value if `x < n` and zero otherwise, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_range_ite_eq_int
declarations.statement: (x : Nat) (c : Int) (n : Nat) : ((List.range n).map (fun i => if i = x then c else 0)).sum = if x < n then c else 0
declarations.doc: A value at one position `x`, summed over `n` positions, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_const
declarations.statement: (c : Nat) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun _ => c)).sum = l.length * c
declarations.doc: A constant summed over a list is the length times the constant, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_const_int
declarations.statement: (c : Int) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun _ => c)).sum = (l.length : Int) * c
declarations.doc: A constant summed over a list is the length times the constant, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_ite_count
declarations.statement: (p : α → Bool) (e : Nat) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun a => if p a then e else 0)).sum = e * (l.filter p).length
declarations.doc: `e` on the elements where a test holds, summed, is `e` times the number of them, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_ite_count_int
declarations.statement: (p : α → Bool) (e : Int) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun a => if p a then e else 0)).sum = e * (l.filter p).length
declarations.doc: `e` on the elements where a test holds, summed, is `e` times the number of them, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_add_ite
declarations.statement: (b : α → Nat) (p : α → Bool) (e : Nat) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun a => b a + if p a then e else 0)).sum = (l.map b).sum + e * (l.filter p).length
declarations.doc: A base amount plus a bonus `e` on the elements where a test holds, summed: the base sum plus `e` times the number of elements with the bonus, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_add_ite_int
declarations.statement: (b : α → Int) (p : α → Bool) (e : Int) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun a => b a + if p a then e else 0)).sum = (l.map b).sum + e * (l.filter p).length
declarations.doc: A base amount plus a bonus `e` on the elements where a test holds, summed, on `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_set_add
declarations.statement: : ∀ (l : List Nat) (i x : Nat) (h : i < l.length), (l.set i x).sum + l[i] = l.sum + x
declarations.doc: A list of `Nat` with the entry at position `i` set to `x`: the new sum plus the old entry is the old sum plus `x`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_set_int
declarations.statement: : ∀ (l : List Int) (i : Nat) (x : Int) (h : i < l.length), (l.set i x).sum = l.sum - l[i] + x
declarations.doc: A list of `Int` with the entry at position `i` set to `x`: the sum changes by `x` minus the old entry.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_set_add
declarations.statement: (g : α → Nat) : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α) (h : i < l.length), ((l.set i x).map g).sum + g l[i] = (l.map g).sum + g x
declarations.doc: A list of records with the record at position `i` replaced by `x`, summed through a field `g` (on `Nat`): the new sum plus the old summand is the old sum plus the new summand.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_set_int
declarations.statement: (g : α → Int) : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α) (h : i < l.length), ((l.set i x).map g).sum = (l.map g).sum - g l[i] + g x
declarations.doc: A list of records with the record at position `i` replaced by `x`, summed through `g` (on `Int`): the sum changes by the new summand minus the old.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_set
declarations.statement: (g : α → Int) (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α) (h : i < l.length) : sumOver (l.set i x) g = sumOver l g - g l[i] + g x
declarations.doc: `sumOver` a list with the element at position `i` replaced by `x`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_set_eq
declarations.statement: (g : α → Nat) (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α) (h : ∀ hi : i < l.length, g x = g l[i]) : ((l.set i x).map g).sum = (l.map g).sum
declarations.doc: Replacing the record at position `i` by one with the same summand leaves the sum unchanged (a position past the end leaves the list unchanged).

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_add_ite
declarations.statement: [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (f : α → Int) (x : α) (d : Int) : sumOver l (fun a => f a + if a = x then d else 0) = sumOver l f + if x ∈ l then d else 0
declarations.doc: Over accounts without duplicates, adding `d` to the balance of one account `x` adds `d` to the total if `x` is an account.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_sub_ite
declarations.statement: [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (f : α → Int) (x : α) (d : Int) : sumOver l (fun a => f a - if a = x then d else 0) = sumOver l f - if x ∈ l then d else 0
declarations.doc: Over accounts without duplicates, subtracting `d` from the balance of one account `x` subtracts `d` from the total if `x` is an account.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_ite_update
declarations.statement: [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (f : α → Int) (x : α) (v : Int) (hx : x ∈ l) : sumOver l (fun a => if a = x then v else f a) = sumOver l f - f x + v
declarations.doc: Over accounts without duplicates, overwriting the balance of an account `x` with `v` changes the total by `v` minus the old balance.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sumOver_move
declarations.statement: [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (f : α → Int) {src dst : α} (x : Int) (hs : src ∈ l) (hd : dst ∈ l) : sumOver l (fun a => (f a - if a = src then x else 0) + if a = dst then x else 0) = sumOver l f
declarations.doc: Over accounts without duplicates, moving `x` from one account to another (both accounts, possibly equal), written with an `if` on each, leaves the total unchanged.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_mul_left
declarations.statement: (c : Nat) (f : α → Nat) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun a => c * f a)).sum = c * (l.map f).sum
declarations.doc: A common factor out of a sum, on `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_mul_left
declarations.statement: (c : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (l.map (fun a => c * a)).sum = c * l.sum
declarations.doc: A common factor out of a sum of a list of `Nat`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_mul_right
declarations.statement: (c : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (l.map (fun a => a * c)).sum = l.sum * c
declarations.doc: A common factor out of a sum of a list of `Nat`, on the right.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_mul_left_int
declarations.statement: (c : Int) (l : List Int) : (l.map (fun a => c * a)).sum = c * l.sum
declarations.doc: A common factor out of a sum of a list of `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_div_add_mod
declarations.statement: (f : α → Nat) (W : Nat) (l : List α) : (l.map f).sum = W * (l.map (fun a => f a / W)).sum + (l.map (fun a => f a % W)).sum
declarations.doc: A sum is `W` times the sum of the quotients by `W` plus the sum of the remainders.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_mod_le
declarations.statement: (f : α → Nat) {W : Nat} (hW : 0 < W) (l : List α) : (l.map (fun a => f a % W)).sum ≤ l.length * (W - 1)
declarations.doc: The remainders by `0 < W`, summed over a list, are at most the length times `W - 1`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_map_mod_lt
declarations.statement: (f : α → Nat) {W : Nat} (hW : 0 < W) {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) : (l.map (fun a => f a % W)).sum < l.length * W
declarations.doc: The remainders by `0 < W`, summed over a nonempty list, are less than the length times `W`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.mul_sum_eq_floor_add_mod
declarations.statement: (A : Nat) (l : List Nat) : l.sum * A = l.sum * (l.map (fun r => A * r / l.sum)).sum + (l.map (fun r => A * r % l.sum)).sum
declarations.doc: `A` times the sum of the ratios, as the rounded-down parts `A * r / l.sum` and their remainders.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.sum_floor_shares_le
declarations.statement: (A : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (l.map (fun r => A * r / l.sum)).sum ≤ A
declarations.doc: The parts of `A` in proportion to the ratios, rounded down, add up to at most `A`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Sums.floor_shares_leftover_lt_length
declarations.statement: (A : Nat) {l : List Nat} (hS : 0 < l.sum) : A - (l.map (fun r => A * r / l.sum)).sum < l.length
declarations.doc: The units of `A` that rounding the proportional parts down leaves over are fewer than the number of parts (for ratios with a positive sum).

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.within_one_of_floor_le
declarations.statement: (a W x : Nat) (hW : 0 < W) (h1 : a / W ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ a / W + 1) : x * W ≤ a + W ∧ a < x * W + W
declarations.doc: A part between the rounded-down quotient `a / W` and one more is within one unit of the exact value: `x * W ≤ a + W` and `a < x * W + W`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.floor_add_bit_within
declarations.statement: (a W e : Nat) (hW : 0 < W) (he : e ≤ 1) : (a / W + e) * W ≤ a + W ∧ a < (a / W + e) * W + W
declarations.doc: The rounded-down quotient plus a bit `e ≤ 1` (a leftover unit or none) is within one unit of the exact value.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.floor_add_bit_within_int
declarations.statement: (a W e : Nat) (hW : 0 < W) (he : e ≤ 1) : ((a / W + e : Nat) : Int) * W ≤ a + W ∧ (a : Int) < ((a / W + e : Nat) : Int) * W + W
declarations.doc: `floor_add_bit_within` with the part, the value and the divisor cast to `Int`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.within_one_of_bounds
declarations.statement: {F W a b : Nat} (h1 : F * W ≤ a) (h2 : a < F * W + W) (hb1 : F ≤ b) (hb2 : b ≤ F + 1) : b * W ≤ a + W ∧ a < b * W + W
declarations.doc: A part at most one unit above a floor `F` of `a / W` (given by its bounds `F * W ≤ a < F * W + W`, as a proof states them) is within one unit of the exact value.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.within_one_of_bounds_int
declarations.statement: {F W a b : Int} (h1 : F * W ≤ a) (h2 : a < F * W + W) (hb : b = F ∨ b = F + 1) : b * W ≤ a + W ∧ a < b * W + W
declarations.doc: `within_one_of_bounds` on `Int`: a part `F` or `F + 1` above a floor `F` of `a / W` is within one unit of the exact value.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.natCast_eq_mul_div_add_mod
declarations.statement: (a n : Nat) : (a : Int) = (n : Int) * ((a : Int) / (n : Int)) + ((a % n : Nat) : Int)
declarations.doc: A natural number, cast to `Int`, as the divisor times the integer quotient of the casts plus the cast remainder.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.add_min_sub_le
declarations.statement: (done q cap : Nat) (h : done ≤ cap) : done + min q (cap - done) ≤ cap
declarations.doc: Adding `min q (cap - done)` to `done ≤ cap` stays within the cap.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.add_min_sub_eq_min
declarations.statement: (done q cap : Nat) (h : done ≤ cap) : done + min q (cap - done) = min (done + q) cap
declarations.doc: Adding `min q (cap - done)` to `done ≤ cap` gives `min (done + q) cap`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.le_add_min_sub
declarations.statement: (done q cap : Nat) : done ≤ done + min q (cap - done)
declarations.doc: Adding `min q (cap - done)` never decreases `done`.

declarations.name: ProofForgeFin.Accrual.sub_add_min_sub
declarations.statement: (done q cap : Nat) : cap - (done + min q (cap - done)) = cap - done - min q (cap - done)
declarations.doc: The capacity left after adding `min q (cap - done)` is the capacity before minus the amount added.
